rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: ProShares Ultra Gold (2x Gold Bullion ETF)
positions.catalyst: Gold printed a fresh multi-week high ~$4,150/oz (+~1.8% on the session) on safe-haven demand — Trump warned of further strikes on Iran and pledged retaliation on any Houthi disruption of Red Sea/Strait of Hormuz shipping, while mediators float a 10-day truce. Fed meeting next week adds an easing-tilt tailwind. Crucially, this catalyst is UNCORRELATED to tonight's triple mega-cap earnings binary: GOOGL (implied ~5-9%), TSLA (~6-8%) and IBM all report after today's close, INSIDE this holding window. Rather than gamble a 2x/3x Nasdaq/semis vehicle through that two-sided print, this book rotates into pure gold bullion, which tends to catch a bid on exactly the risk-off outcome that would hurt leveraged tech.
positions.driver: Long 2x gold BULLION (not miners) as an asymmetric safe-haven play into a known risk-event night. Chose UGL over NUGT/GDX because miners carry equity-market beta that would get dragged in a risk-off earnings selloff, defeating the hedge; bullion is the cleaner uncorrelated vehicle. Entered UNEXTENDED at +3.4% (46.62 ask vs 45.06 close) — NUGT was already +7.9% (chase risk). 2x (not 3x — none broadly liquid for bullion anyway) matches moderate-high conviction on continuation of a strong momentum/safe-haven trend, not a single explosive binary. Hard stop 42.89 (-8% on 2x).
positions.risks: A sudden Iran de-escalation / confirmed truce, a risk-on 'all-clear' from tonight's mega-cap earnings, or a hawkish Fed surprise next week could unwind the safe-haven bid; 2x amplifies both directions and leveraged bullion ETFs carry daily-reset decay if gold chops sideways. Gold is somewhat extended after a multi-session run. Hard stop 42.89 (-8%).
